metadata.name: D1X-Rebirth
metadata.summary: Source port of the classic six-degrees-of-freedom first-person shooter Descent

content.value: D1X-Rebirth is an open-source source port of the classic 1995 six-degrees-of-freedom first-person shooter Descent. Powered by SDL and OpenGL, it updates the original game engine for modern operating systems while preserving the authentic gameplay, feel, and mechanics of the original release.
It provides full backwards compatibility with original DOS player files, savegames, custom missions, and demos, alongside modern graphical, input, and networking enhancements.

items.value: OpenGL-accelerated rendering offering high resolutions, arbitrary aspect ratios, VSync, and optional visual effects like colored lighting and texture filtering
Extensive input handling via SDL with simultaneous keyboard, mouse, and multi-axis joystick support
Multiplayer action over LAN and Internet using UDP/IP with optional Online Tracker integration
Custom digital audio playback from hard drive alongside traditional MIDI and CD-Audio support
High framerate glitch fixes and improved backwards-compatible demo recording
Support for original expansion content, third-party levels, and custom AddOn packs
